[package]
workspace = "../../../../.."
name = "semio-s-imperative-extension-sdk"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "Shared manifest + evaluate helpers for imperative path extensions"

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "s-module"
id = "imperative-extension-sdk"

[lints]
workspace = true

[lib]
crate-type = ["rlib"]
path = "🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-pack = { path = "../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🎒️pack/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-pack-json = { path = "../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🎒️pack/🔤️json/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
neural_engine = { path = "../../../../../../🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🧠️neural/⚙️engine/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-os-kernel-neural-engine" }
# 🎒️ `os_pack::json::to_json_string`/`from_json_str` + `DslValue`/`ToValue`/`FromValue` — this file's
# own `semio_framework_os_kernel::DslValue::object(...)` call (TopicContribution region) already
# assumed this dependency without declaring it (pre-existing gap, found and fixed while converting
# `OperatorInfo`/`Dictionary` off serde — RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS,
# 26/09/01, tenth-seam pass). No cycle: `os-kernel` only reaches this crate via its OWN
# `[dev-dependencies]` (`imperative` plugin, test-only).
# 🔤️ `serde_json::Value`/`json!` only — `evaluate_request_json`/`evaluate_invoke`'s untyped
# passthrough envelope, unrelated to `Dictionary`/`OperatorInfo`. Plain `serde` dropped: nothing in
# this file references it directly any more (tenth-seam pass, see the docstring above).
serde_json.workspace = true
semio-framework = { path = "../../../../../../🧰️framework/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework" }
semio-framework-plugin = { path = "../../../../../../🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-plugin" }
semio-framework-job = { path = "../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🧵️job/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-job" }

[dev-dependencies]

[package]
workspace = "../../../../../.."
name = "semio-hub-stdio-pdf"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "Stdio family component: the PDF 1.4 and 1.7 document apps with their ISO profiles"

[lints]
workspace = true

# 🔗️ `stdio` owns every kind this family opens (definitions, codecs, hub-native codec closure); the family ships only the
# apps, so the host loads `stdio` beside it (`.depends_on("stdio", tree_pin!())` mirrors this row).
[package.metadata.semio]
role = "hub"

[lib]
path = "../../🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-pack = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🎒️pack/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
# 🧩️ Composition Dependencies
semio-s-artifact-stdio-pdf = { workspace = true }
# /🧩️ Composition Dependencies
semio-s-artifact-stdio-contract = { workspace = true }
semio-framework = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-dispatch-macros = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-job = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-plugin = { workspace = true }

[package.metadata.semio.preparation]
script = "../../../../📦️packages/🦀️rust/📜️script.ts"
command = ["composition", "prepare"]

[package]
workspace = "../../../../../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-os-kernel-db-io-registry"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "Db I/O kernel backend registry, close and retirement turns"

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "product"
id = "os-db-io-registry"

[package.metadata.semio.rust-source-boundary]
maxSourceBytes = 262144
maxSourceFiles = 32
maxActiveLines = 4000

[lints]
workspace = true

[lib]
name = "db_io_registry"
path = "../../🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-os-kernel-db-ids = { path = "../../../../🆔️ids/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-os-kernel-db-io-core = { path = "../../../🧱️io-core/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-async = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-hash = { path = "../../../../../../../../🔨️modules/🔏️hash/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-pack = { workspace = true }

[dev-dependencies]
semio-framework-os-kernel-db-io-core = { path = "../../../🧱️io-core/📦️packages/🦀️rust", features = ["testkit"] }
serde_json = { workspace = true }
